title: New Feature Kickoff
summary: Peter Chen and Quinn Taylor discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for this sprint, but Peter Chen's revised estimate is next quarter. The conflict was not resolved.
notes: CONFLICTING DEADLINES: Database migration deadline stated as 'this sprint' early in meeting, then revised to 'next quarter'. Conflict unresolved at end of meeting.
defect_description: The same database migration task has two conflicting deadlines: 'this sprint' and 'next quarter'. The AI should flag the conflict rather than arbitrarily picking one.
